subject: Nvim-R: width of R console not fully used by R output in tmux pane

messages.author: 34aae2227f44592b
messages.subject: Nvim-R: width of R console not fully used by R output in tmux pane
parts:
Hi,

I really enjoy using the plugin and since I switched from Vim-R-plugin to the new Nvim-R with Neovim I experience less issues making it even better.

However, one new issue has arisen since I have switched: only part of the width of the R console is used by the output of R. I have "let R_in_buffer = 0" in my vimrc and instead the R console is in a separate tmux pane. Whenever the output is longer than about 80 characters, it changes to a new line even if there is plenty of space to print more on the same line. I did not have this with the Vim-R-plugin and the old Vim, where the output was the full width available even if the width of the R console had changed since it was created. The issue seems unaffected by the settings of R_editor_w and R_rconsole_width in vimrc.

Any advice on how to fix this?

messages.author: 34aae2227f44592b
messages.subject: Re: Nvim-R: width of R console not fully used by R output in tmux pane
parts:
Wait. I just discovered that this also happens outside of vim and the R plugin. Even in plain xterm without tmux.

Sorry for posting this. Any advice still appreciated. ;)

messages.author: b256a2742aacd200
messages.subject: Re: Nvim-R: width of R console not fully used by R output in tmux pane
parts:
Did you install setwidth and put in your .Rprofile
library("setwidth")

?

messages.author: 34aae2227f44592b
messages.subject: Re: Nvim-R: width of R console not fully used by R output in tmux pane
parts: Ah, yes, you are right. I forgot that used to be in my .Rprofile, but I commented out everything but there by the automatic configuration by Vim-R-plugin. Thanks!
